name: Tanoue Shingo
source:
Hobbies: Basking in the sun on holidays
Likes: Peace
Dislikes: Violent incidents

A man who works at the police station on Chuo street in Chisakura town. He is a pacifist and has a calm personality, he does not like any kind of conflicts.

[Translated from [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/b-cyc-pro/mdb-dvd2/cha/mdbdvd_cha14.htm]official website[/url].]
